urv9eu7810qd4sqjvlricdqtso: How far p is from a ring (a torus) lying flat around the origin. The formula is Inigo Quilez's torus, from https://iquilezles.org/articles/distfunctions/.
t8p8dbn9irpk3eesbn2pdf12c7: The nearer of two shapes, with the seam between them rounded off so they melt together. This is Inigo Quilez's polynomial smooth minimum, from https://iquilezles.org/articles/smin/.

Hart's method ("Sphere tracing: a geometric method for the antialiased ray tracing of implicit surfaces", The Visual Computer, 1996): the scene says how far is surely empty, so step that far and ask again. Stops on a surface, past 20, or after 120 steps. A loop on the GPU, since the call to itself is its last step.

It stops after 64 steps, as Quilez's own loop does: on a GPU, a loop that never ends freezes the whole browser, and with 32-bit floats some pixel's never did. This is Inigo Quilez's soft shadow, from https://iquilezles.org/articles/rmshadows/.
eshm7a5ef1erjshv7d9jd6ugnt: The colour of the sky looking in a direction this steep: paler at the horizon.
g7bf60oa8upqsibuj4ph3tgjtf: 0 or 1 in a checkerboard of half-unit squares on the floor under p.
9llh56o35attq62halcqgona2f: The colour of the surface at p. The normal, the direction the surface faces, is the gradient of the scene: how fast scene changes along x, along y and along z, as one Vec. gradient reads it off scene itself (for the GPU, before the shader is compiled), so it is exact and follows any edit to scene, instead of being estimated by sampling nearby points (computing normals from the distance's gradient is standard practice; differentiating the program before compiling it for the GPU is what Enzyme does).
t4pma75h0imolv3puct9l0h2hb: What the camera sees through the pixel at (x, y): follow a ray from the camera through it and shade what it hits, fading into the sky with distance; or show the sky.
t353g46bonarkbro9sbp03amv0: The colour of the pixel at (x, y): what trace sees, within a budget. march and shadow stop after so many steps, but a step count on a Number isn't something the checker can trust (NaN + 1 is NaN, and NaN < 120 is false), so their types say Diverge, and a GPU won't take that. with fuel allows 1000 calls to them, about five times what a pixel needs, and first gives magenta if a pixel ever runs out, so it shows. A budget like this is an old idea: gas in Ethereum, fuel in Wasmtime.
program:
Adapted: march is sphere tracing, John C. Hart's method ("Sphere tracing: a geometric method for the antialiased ray tracing of implicit surfaces", The Visual Computer, 1996).
Adapted: the ring's distance, the smooth minimum and the soft shadow are Inigo Quilez's formulas: https://iquilezles.org/articles/distfunctions/ https://iquilezles.org/articles/smin/ https://iquilezles.org/articles/rmshadows/
Our own: the scene (a drop in a ring over a checker floor), and normals read off the scene by gradient before the shader is compiled.
Prior art: differentiating a program before compiling it for the GPU is what Enzyme does (Moses and Churavy, NeurIPS 2020).
Influence: the fuel budget is an old idea: gas in Ethereum, fuel in Wasmtime.
